CustomObject.description: Maps a case scenario to an email template. The AI flow queries these records to build a candidate shortlist before the LLM selects and drafts.
CustomObject.label: Template Scenario

fields.label: When To Use
fields.description: One or two sentences describing when a CSR should use this template. Example: Use when a practice is requesting a Medical Director change on a credentialed account.

fields.label: Template Body
fields.description: The full email template text including all mandatory language, form names, SLAs, and placeholders.

fields.label: Case Type
fields.description: Matches the Case.Type picklist value. Used by the flow to filter relevant templates.

fields.label: Case Reason
fields.description: Matches the Case.Reason picklist value. Used by the flow to filter relevant templates.

fields.label: Is Active
fields.description: Inactive records are excluded from the flow query.
